decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 6 December 2005, the erection of a single storey side extension measuring a height of 2.9m, a width of 2.21m and a length of 4.03m was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the total volume of the extension does not exceed 70m3.

Informative: The applicant is advised that the side extension approved by this Certificate of Lawfulness shall be completed before any work on the single-storey front, side and rear extension to the house approved under planning application ref: 00807/12/P1 is commenced. If you commence work on the front, rear or side extension before you have completed this side extension you will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the side extension.  As a result you will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000. It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey side extension to house.
